D1-hand-front.material_note: yield strength (ASM); used for the whole box (6061-T6 parts are stronger)

material_data.name: 5052-H32 aluminium
material_data.note: yield strength (ASM); used for the whole box (6061-T6 parts are stronger)

peak.where: sharp inside corner (no fillet: the peak there rises as the mesh is refined)
peak.note: the design peak sits in a 3.2 mm wall only 1.1 elements thick: a peak in a wall one or two elements thick is not a result. Mesh finer there (refine=[(point, radius, size)], a size under 1.1 mm) and check it with converge(); the peak is at a sharp re-entrant corner, which is singular: its stress rises with every refinement and never converges. Model the fillet the part will have

D1-hand-front.assumptions: linear elastic, small deflection, isotropic; faces clamped where fixed; no contact, preload or buckling
D1-hand-front.why: 300 N down on the deck at the front (a child leaning on it)
D1-hand-front.note_by_part: the deck and riser at 5052-H32's 193 MPa, the turret plate at 6061-T6's 276 MPa; the deck within 4 mm of a post pad (a rigid-clamp corner) reported apart, against the abuse target 1.2
D1-hand-front.corner_check: reported only (finer than the 4 mm reference)
